svg.title: Shared memory and locks compared with actors and messages
svg.desc: Left: three goroutines read and write one shared stock variable, and each must take a lock first. Forgetting the lock is a data race, taking two locks in different orders can deadlock, and goroutines that need the stock wait for each other. Right: Alice and Bob send Buy messages to a shop actor. The messages wait in the shop's mailbox, and only the shop reads and writes its stock, one message at a time, so no lock is needed. Other code learns the stock by asking the shop with a message.
